panels.notes: Defaults used for integrated LED panel and troffer concepts when Step 1 evidence does not provide a stronger SKU-specific value.

defaults.selectable_wattage: TBD from Step 1 evidence and supplier options
defaults.selectable_cct: TBD from Step 1 evidence and supplier options
defaults.dimming_type: 0-10V dimming target unless Step 1 evidence names TRIAC or another control type
defaults.moisture_rating: Damp rated target for commercial indoor ceiling applications; validate listing claim
defaults.emergency_battery: Only if Step 1 evidence names emergency backup
defaults.run_time: 90-minute target only when emergency backup is included
defaults.motion_sensor: Only if Step 1 evidence names motion or sensor-ready functionality
defaults.daylight_sensor_auto_dimming: Optional; validate demand before adding complexity
defaults.smart_connected: No unless Step 1 evidence specifically supports controls/connectivity
defaults.beam_angle: Wide commercial ceiling distribution; exact photometrics TBD
defaults.certifications: ETL or UL, DLC where required, FCC/RoHS as applicable
defaults.warranty: 5 year target; validate against supplier warranty and Sunco category standard

decorative_fixture.notes: Defaults used only when the Step 1 evidence does not provide a stronger value. These are intended as research starting points, not locked PRD specs.

defaults.driver_type: Replaceable lamp sockets unless integrated LED is selected
defaults.moisture_rating: Dry rated indoor use; damp-rated variant only if bathroom or covered damp use is intended
defaults.warranty: 3 year target; validate against supplier warranty and Sunco category standard

defaults.target_msrp: TBD from competitor median by size/bulb count
defaults.target_vendor_cost: TBD after target MSRP and margin gate

under_cabinet.notes: Defaults used for under-cabinet task-lighting concepts when Step 1 evidence does not provide a stronger SKU-specific value.

defaults.voltage: Battery rechargeable or 120V plug-in/hardwire by kit type
defaults.dimming_type: Touch/remote dimming for puck kits; inline/controller dimming for tape kits
defaults.driver_type: Rechargeable battery pack or listed low-voltage driver by kit type
defaults.moisture_rating: Dry/damp indoor cabinet use; validate exact listing claim
defaults.wiring_type: Rechargeable magnetic mount, plug-in, or hardwired by SKU
defaults.motion_duration: TBD by supplier; target selectable auto-off
defaults.daylight_sensor_auto_dimming: Optional; validate demand before adding complexity
defaults.linkable: Yes for bar/tape variants; not required for puck kits
defaults.beam_angle: Wide task-light distribution; exact optics TBD
defaults.target_msrp: TBD from competitor median by pack count and kit type
defaults.certifications: ETL, UL, FCC where controls/batteries apply
defaults.warranty: 3 year target; validate battery warranty separately
